field_evidence.resource: Shut in lifts incidents attended by LFB in last 36 months
field_evidence.description_scope: Complete list of shut-in-lift releases for the stated period; incident information includes postcode, borough and ward.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade dataset 'Shut in lift releases (lift entrapments) attended by LFB'. It is a complete list for the stated 36-month period, updated monthly, and includes incident location information including postcode, borough and ward. The current resource covers August 2023 through July 2026 under Open Government Licence v2. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity to that unused ward-level public source window; Campden-row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
